evidence.note: The contemporaneous preprint supports recurring hallucinations in the tested systems and tasks, but does not establish deterioration or executive behavior.
The timely version reports both gains and regressions. It does not establish either broad deterioration or broad improvement across relevant AI systems.
IBM's survey disclosure reports integration and risk concerns. It does not measure maximum adoption speed or link deployments to known unsuitability.

reviews.rationale: Recurring hallucinations are supported. General deterioration and rapid adoption regardless of suitability remain unsettled. Task-specific improvements and reported executive concerns do not decisively contradict the broader assertions, so the compound claim remains unresolved.
